dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs and tree decompositions XIV. Non-adjacent neighbours …
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every fixed $t \geq 1$, the family of $t$-clock-free graphs is clean.
dossier_meta.context_text: A $t$-clock is a clock consisting of a hole $C$ and a vertex $v$ such that there are two neighbours $x, y \in V(C)$ of $v$ where the distance between $x$ and $y$ along $C$ is at least $t$. The main result of the paper (Theorem 1.1) establishes cleanness for $t = 2$ (all clocks); Conjecture 1.3 proposes that cleanness persists even when clocks with close non-adjacent pairs are allowed, for every fixed threshold $t$.
